digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict routing and degradation handling
propositions: Injecting CriteriaError during criteria assembly was incorrectly routed through the generic LLM degradation tail, producing llm_unavailable=true when no LLM call executed.
The workflow interpreter records scripted exceptions as undifferentiated strings, losing typed exception identity that would discriminate config failures from genuine LLM unavailability.

Plan review verdicts for stale/malformed repository criteria must fail-closed as INDETERMINATE with a distinct config_fault marker and actionable diagnostic naming the installed build, not the provider.

The structured CriteriaError marker must be preserved from the assemble boundary and routed before generic LLM degradation, preserving deterministic coverage and honoring existing LLM-outage vs. config-fault boundaries.
A config-fault verdict must omit the affirmative llm_unavailable label, preserve full DET findings, and direct operators toward repository checkout build remediation.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider paths must remain behaviorally unchanged by the discriminating config-fault repair.
